name: Ananias
overview: The New Testament presents Ananias in several distinct roles, notably highlighting a tragic example of deceit within the early church. In Acts 5, Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, sold a piece of property but deceitfully withheld part of the proceeds while claiming to give the full amount to the apostles. Peter confronts Ananias, revealing that his lie was ultimately against God, not merely men, which led to Ananias' sudden death and instilled great fear among the believers. This account underscores the seriousness of integrity before God and the consequences of hypocrisy in the Christian community.
